properties.description: An Artifact is an orphan only when every edge it carries is bookkeeping — a document attached by DOCUMENTS and a contract attached by SPECIFIES are attached (BL-176). Six cases in crates/reflow2-core/tests/orphan_attachment.rs. What must still fire is pinned: an artifact attached by nothing, a document that documents nothing (artifact_type is never a free pass), and an artifact carrying only a Release INCLUDES edge — which is why this is NOT the degree-zero rule the Decision arm uses.
properties.findings: WRITTEN BEFORE THE FIX, and the split is the evidence: the 2 defect cases FAILED and all 4 counterweights PASSED against the old rule, so the counterweights were not passing by accident of the bug.
properties.name: An Artifact is an orphan only when every edge it carries is bookkeeping
